(b64/encodeNoPad (stringToBytes \"f\")) \"Zg\") \"unpadded encode f\")\n      (assert (= (b64/encodeNoPad (stringToBytes \"fo\")) \"Zm8\") \"unpadded encode fo\")\n      (assert (= (b64/encodeStringNoPad \"foob\") \"Zm9vYg\") \"unpadded string encoding\")\n      (assert (= (b64/decode \"Zg\") (ok (stringToBytes \"f\"))) \"unpadded decode f\")\n      (assert (= (b64/decode \"Zm8\") (ok (stringToBytes \"fo\"))) \"unpadded decode fo\")\n      (assert (= (b64/decode \"Zm9vYg\") (ok (stringToBytes \"foob\"))) \"unpadded decode foob\")\n      (assert (= (b64/decode (b64/decode \"Zm$v\")) \"invalid character is err\")\n      (assert (err? (b64/decode \"Zg=\")) \"short padding is err\")\n      (assert (err? (b64/decode \"Zm=v\")) \"embedded padding is err\")\n      (assert (err? (b64/decode \"Zh==\")) \"nonzero trailing bits are err\")\n      (assert (err? (b64/decode \"Zm9=\")) \"nonzero trailing bits with one pad are err\")\n      (assert (err? (b64/decodeUrlSafe \"_\")) \"url-safe invalid length is err\")\n      (assert (err? (b64/decodeToString \"Zm$v\")) \"string decoder preserves malformed err\")\n      true))\n\nfn runTests -> Bool\n  (and (testRfcEncode)\n    (and (testRfcDecode)\n      (and (testOptionalPadding)\n        (and (testUrlSafe) (testMalformed))))))\n")
```
(module asl-text/base64
  :x [encode encodeNoPad encodeUrlSafe encodeUrlSafePad
      encodeString encodeStringNoPad encodeUrlSafeString encodeUrlSafeStringPad
      decode decodeUrlSafe decodeBytes decodeUrlSafeBytes
      decodeToString decodeUrlSafeToString]
  :i [(asl-syntax/core/bytesText :a bt)])

fn stdAlpha -> String
  "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

fn urlAlpha -> String
  "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_"

fn b64Char alpha: String v: Int64 -> String
  (optionOr (stringSlice alpha v (+ v 1)) "")

fn addPadding s: String -> String
  (let [(r (mod (stringLength s) 4))]
    (if (= r 2)
      (str s "==")
      (if (= r 3) (str s "=") s)))

fn encLoop bytes: Bytes alpha: String i: Int64 n: Int64 acc: String -> String
  (if (>= i n)
    acc
    (let [(rem (- n i))
          (b0 (bytesGet bytes i))
          (b1 (if (< (+ i 1) n) (bytesGet bytes (+ i 1)) 0))
          (b2 (if (< (+ i 2) n) (bytesGet bytes (+ i 2)) 0))
          (v0 (/ b0 4))
          (v1 (+ (* (mod b0 4) 16) (/ b1 16)))
          (v2 (+ (* (mod b1 16) 4) (/ b2 64)))
          (v3 (mod b2 64))]
      (encLoop bytes alpha (+ i 3) n
        (str acc
          (b64Char alpha v0)
          (b64Char alpha v1)
          (if (> rem 1) (b64Char alpha v2) "")
          (if (> rem 2) (b64Char alpha v3) ""))))) :rawFields "content")

encodeUrlSafeStringPad s: String -> String\n  (encodeUrlSafePad (stringToBytes s))\n\nfn stripPadLen bytes: Bytes n: Int64 -> Int64\n  (if (and (> n 0) (= (bytesGet bytes (- n 1)) 61))\n    (stripPadLen bytes (- n 1))\n    n)\n\nfn validShape m: Int64 n: Int64 -> Bool\n  (let [(p (- m n))\n        (r (mod n 4))]\n    (if (= r 1)\n      false\n      (if (= p 0)\n        true\n        (if (not (= (mod m 4) 0))\n          false\n          (if (= r 2)\n            (= p 2)\n            (if (= r 3) (= p 1) false)))))))\n\nfn decOutLen n: Int64 -> Int64\n  (let [(full (* 3 (/ n 4)))\n        (r (mod n 4))]\n    (if (= r 2) (+ full 1) (if (= r 3) (+ full 2) full)))\n\nfn charVal alphaBytes: Bytes c: Int64 i: Int64 -> Int64\n  (if (>= i 64)\n    -1\n    (if (= (bytesGet alphaBytes i) c)\n      i\n      (charVal alphaBytes c (+ i 1)))))\n\nfn decLoop src: Bytes alphaBytes: Bytes i: Int64 n: Int64 out: Bytes -> (Result Bytes String)\n  (if (>= i n)\n    (ok out)\n    (let [(rem (min 4 (- (stdAlpha))\n\nfn decodeUrlSafeBytes src: Bytes -> (Result Bytes String)\n  (decodeBytesWith src (urlAlpha))\n\nfn decode s: String -> (Result Bytes String)\n  (decodeBytes (stringToBytes s))\n\nfn decodeUrlSafe s: String -> (Result Bytes String)\n  (decodeUrlSafeBytes (stringToBytes s))\n\nfn decodeToString s: String -> (Result String String)\n  (match (decode s)\n    ((ok bytes) (ok (bt/bytesToString bytes)))\n    ((err e) (err e)))\n\nfn decodeUrlSafeToString s: String -> (Result String String)\n  (match (decodeUrlSafe s)\n    ((ok bytes) (ok (bt/bytesToString bytes)))\n    ((err e) (err e)))\n" :rawFields "content")
(:step :op "gate")
